          <span class="review-date">Carol Putnam</span>
        </div>
        <div class="review-content">
          <p class="review-summary">
            Review of Carol Putnam's groundbreaking work on interaction forces in the golf swing and how they 
            automatically create the proximal-to-distal sequencing pattern. This research demonstrates how 
            interaction forces facilitate the transfer of energy from larger, proximal segments to smaller, 
            distal segments, creating the characteristic kinematic sequence that maximizes clubhead speed.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="review-content">
          <p class="review-summary">
            Comprehensive review of induced acceleration analysis research, featuring the foundational work of 
            Felix Zajac and other key contributors. This method decomposes the acceleration of each segment into 
            contributions from individual forces, allowing researchers to understand which muscles and forces are 
            responsible for specific aspects of movement in biomechanical systems.
          </p>
        </div>
